title: Koko's Kitchen

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Koko's Kitchen.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Koko]] |location= Kakariko Village |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Hasty Veggie Cream Soup }} |previous= |next= {{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[Cooking with Koko]]}} }} "{{Term/Store|Koko's Kitchen||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Koko's Kitchen}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Kakariko Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== The [[Side Quest]] begins when [[Link]] speaks to [[Koko]] while she is standing at one of the [[Cooking Pot]]s in [[Kakariko Village]]. Koko shares her plan to make [[Veggie Cream Soup]], as she has heard it is nourishing and fortifying.{{Cite|Today's dinner is {{Color BotW|Blue|veggie cream soup}}! It's super nourishing and fortifying! Well, that's what they say, anyhow. It must be true!|Koko|BotW}} She shares the recipe, which is stewing a [[Swift Carrot]], [[Rock Salt]], and [[Fresh Milk]] together in a Cooking Pot.{{Cite|All you do is toss a {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrot}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|rock salt}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|fresh milk}} in a pot and stew it up. Then, voilà! So yummy!|Koko|BotW}} However, Koko panics when she realizes that she does not have any Swift Carrots.{{Cite|{{Big|...OH, NO!}} Koko is all out of {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrots}}!|Koko|BotW}} She becomes sad, recalling that she promised [[Hasty Veggie Cream Soup]] to her sister, [[Cottla]].{{Cite|But...Koko promised to make Cottla some {{Color BotW|Blue|hasty veggie cream soup}}...|Koko|BotW}} Link can offer to help Koko by fetching some Swift Carrots, which she will be grateful for.{{Cite|[I'll bring you some.] Thank you! So much!|Koko|BotW}} Koko says that she only needs one and she will wait for Link to get it.{{Cite|OK, Koko just needs one {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrot}}! Just one and Koko can get cookin'! Koko will be waiting for you here!|Koko|BotW}} Once night comes, though, she will need to go home.{{Cite|{{Small|Though, once it gets dark out, Koko will have to head home...}}|Koko|BotW}} If Link takes too long, Koko will go home for the night and he will have to return during the daytime when she goes back to the kitchen. Should Link refuse to help her or withholds Swift Carrots, Koko will call him cold.{{Cite|Oooh, that's cold...|Koko|BotW}} The nearby [[General Store]], [[High Spirits Produce]], sells Swift Carrots. Several [[Merchant]]s in the area also offer Swift Carrots. Koko continues to chastise herself for being so forgetful, and she begins to think she is a bad sister who is unable to look after Cottla the way their mother could.{{Cite|Koko promised to make Cottla some {{Color BotW|Blue|hasty veggie cream soup}}... But silly Koko forgot the {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrots}}! Koko is supposed to take Mother's place for Cottla... Koko is a bad big sister...|Koko|BotW}} If Link has a Swift Carrot in his [[Inventory]], Koko will be able to smell them.{{Cite|...Huh? {{Big|HUH?!}} Koko smells {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrots}}...|Koko|BotW}} Once Link hands one over, she happily thanks him and begins to [[Cooking|Cook]].{{Cite|{{Big|Is that...a {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrot}}?!}} Thank you so much! So very much! Now Koko can make dinner for Cottla... Yeah! Time to get cookin'!|Koko|BotW}} As soon as dinner is finished, Koko will give some of her Hasty Veggie Cream Soup to Link to reward him for his help, ending the Side Quest.{{Cite|Ooooh, it came out perfect! Here, please have some! Koko's treat!|Koko|BotW}} She goes on to say that she intends to keep experimenting in the kitchen to become an excellent cook like her mother.{{Cite|Koko wants to try cooking different things so Koko can be a great chef, just like Mother!|Koko|BotW}} If Link has a full [[Inventory]], Koko will complain that she is unable to give him the [[Meal]].{{Cite|Huh? Your pouch is full? But Koko can't give you any food if you don't have room for it! Koko worked so hard to make it... Koko wanted to thank you...|Koko|BotW}} After Link makes space for the Soup, Koko will be happy.{{Cite|You made space in your pouch for Koko? Oh, you've made Koko so happy! Thank you so much!|Koko|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Today's special is hasty veggie cream soup! At least, that's what Koko had in mind, but she forgot to stock up on {{Color BotW|Red|swift carrots}}, the key ingredient.

Hasty veggie cream soup is her little sister Cottla's favorite meal, and Koko hates to see her cry. If only she had some {{Color BotW|Red|swift carrots}}... |- | Complete | Koko was panicking after forgetting to stock up on swift carrots for the hasty veggie cream soup. But now that she has the ingredients she needs, there's a big smile on both Koko's and Cottla's faces.

　　 {{Color BotW|Red|/////Koko's Recipe Corner/////}}
One serving of hasty veggie cream soup:

Add rock salt and fresh milk to a bowl of swift carrots. Heat and stir to taste. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Kakariko Village * Koko * Swift Carrot * Veggie Cream Soup }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
